## Modules

- [Phoenix.Component](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.Component.md): Define reusable function components with HEEx templates.
- [Phoenix.LiveComponent](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveComponent.md): LiveComponents are a mechanism to compartmentalize state, markup, and
events for sharing across LiveViews.
- [Phoenix.LiveView](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.md): A LiveView is a process that receives events, updates
its state, and renders updates to a page as diffs.
- [Phoenix.LiveView.AsyncResult](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.AsyncResult.md): Provides a data structure for tracking the state of an async assign.
- [Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedCSS](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedCSS.md): Building blocks for a special HEEx `:type` that extracts any CSS styles
from a colocated `<style>` tag at compile time.
- [Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedHook](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedHook.md): A special HEEx `:type` that extracts [hooks](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/js-interop.md#client-hooks-via-phx-hook)
from a co-located `<script>` tag at compile time.
- [Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedJS](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.ColocatedJS.md): A special HEEx `:type` that extracts any JavaScript code from a co-located
`<script>` tag at compile time.
- [Phoenix.LiveView.Controller](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Controller.md): Helpers for rendering LiveViews from a controller.

- [Phoenix.LiveView.Debug](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Debug.md): Functions for runtime introspection and debugging of LiveViews.
- [Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLFormatter.TagFormatter](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLFormatter.TagFormatter.md): A behaviour for formatting specific tags.

- [Phoenix.LiveView.JS](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.JS.md): Provides commands for executing JavaScript utility operations on the client.
- [Phoenix.LiveView.Router](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Router.md): Provides LiveView routing for Phoenix routers.

- [Phoenix.LiveViewTest](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveViewTest.md): Conveniences for testing function components as well as
LiveViews and LiveComponents.

- Configuration
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLFormatter](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLFormatter.md): Format HEEx templates from `.heex` files or `~H` sigils.
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.Logger](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Logger.md): Instrumenter to handle logging of `Phoenix.LiveView` and `Phoenix.LiveComponent` life-cycle events.
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.Socket](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Socket.md): The LiveView socket for Phoenix Endpoints.

- Testing structures
  - [Phoenix.LiveViewTest.Element](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveViewTest.Element.md): The struct returned by `Phoenix.LiveViewTest.element/3`.
  - [Phoenix.LiveViewTest.Upload](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveViewTest.Upload.md): The struct returned by `Phoenix.LiveViewTest.file_input/4`.
  - [Phoenix.LiveViewTest.View](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveViewTest.View.md): The struct for testing LiveViews.

- Upload structures
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.UploadConfig](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.UploadConfig.md): The struct representing an upload.

  - [Phoenix.LiveView.UploadEntry](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.UploadEntry.md): The struct representing an upload entry.

  - [Phoenix.LiveView.UploadWriter](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.UploadWriter.md): Provides a behavior for writing uploaded chunks to a final destination.

- Plugin API
  - [Phoenix.LiveComponent.CID](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveComponent.CID.md): The struct representing an internal unique reference to the component instance,
available as the `@myself` assign in live components.
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.Component](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Component.md): The struct returned by components in .heex templates.
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.Comprehension](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Comprehension.md): The struct returned by for-comprehensions in .heex templates.

  - [Phoenix.LiveView.Engine](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Engine.md): An `EEx` template engine that tracks changes.
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLEngine](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLEngine.md): The HTMLEngine that powers `.heex` templates and the `~H` sigil.
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.Rendered.md): The struct returned by .heex templates.
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine.md): Building blocks for tag based `Phoenix.Template.Engine`s.

- Exceptions
  - [Phoenix.LiveView.ReloadError](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Phoenix.LiveView.ReloadError.md)

## Mix Tasks

- [mix compile.phoenix_live_view](https://phoenix-live-view.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Compile.PhoenixLiveView.md): A LiveView compiler for HEEx macro components.
